entity_types.name: Government
entity_types.description: Sovereign policymaking bodies: Fed/FOMC, Treasury, Congress, BOJ, SAFE, BLS

attributes.name: influence_tier
attributes.description: high/medium/low impact on the 10Y yield forecast

attributes.name: stance
attributes.description: Current policy stance (hawkish/dovish/neutral) or issuance guidance

entity_types.selection_rule: Any governmental body whose policy decisions (rates, issuance, budgets, FX reserves, data) causally affect the 10Y Treasury yield
anti_examples: 财政部发布的DGS10数据序列本身（属信号客体）
levers: 调整缩表/资产负债表操作
调整国债拍卖规模与久期结构
立法改变税收/支出/债务上限
调整外储中美元资产配置

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: Individual decision-makers: Fed chair, FOMC voters, Treasury Secretary

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Position held (e.g., Fed Chair, FOMC voter, Treasury Secretary)

entity_types.selection_rule: Named individuals with direct votes or decisions affecting monetary/fiscal policy relevant to the yield
anti_examples: 被引用的经济学家专栏作者

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Non-state institutions: CBO, NY Fed model team, rating agencies, dealers, strategy desks
examples: 摩根大通利率策略团队
entity_types.selection_rule: Organizations that shape fiscal expectations, risk pricing, market liquidity or forecasts of the 10Y yield
anti_examples: 预测市场平台页面本身
levers: 发布赤字/债务基线预测
发布期限溢价与衰退概率模型
在拍卖中缩减承接/压低投标

entity_types.name: TreasuryInstrument
entity_types.description: Trackable asset objects: 10Y note, 2Y, 3M, TIPS, JGB, bills
entity_types.selection_rule: Specific tradable securities whose yields/prices are tracked for the forecast
anti_examples: “期限溢价”这一抽象分解量（归MacroIndicator）
收益率曲线形态概念本身

entity_types.name: MacroIndicator
entity_types.description: Official signal series: term premium, breakeven, spread, recession prob, MOVE
entity_types.selection_rule: Quantitative time series whose levels/thresholds discriminate between forecast scenarios

entity_types.name: ForecastSource
entity_types.description: Cited research/media outlets providing yield forecasts (passive sources)

attributes.name: published_view
attributes.description: Point estimate or scenario range for 2027 10Y yield

examples: 摩根大通财富管理展望
entity_types.selection_rule: Media/survey/prediction-market entities cited as evidence but not causally deciding the outcome
anti_examples: CBO（直接影响财政立法预期，归Organization）

edge_types.name: INFLUENCES
edge_types.description: Source shapes target's decisions, cost of funding or risk pricing
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 影响/施压 target 的决策或定价（如评级机构影响财政部融资成本）

edge_types.name: SUPPLIES
edge_types.description: Source supplies securities, data or estimates to target
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 向 target 供应（财政部向交易商发行国债；BLS向美联储供应数据）

edge_types.name: COMPETES_WITH
edge_types.description: Source's policy normalization competes for the same investor demand

attributes.name: dimension
attributes.description: e.g., global safe-asset demand / yield differential

edge_types.direction_semantics: source 与 target 在吸引债券资金/利差上竞争（BOJ加息 vs 美联储，驱动日本资金回流）

edge_types.name: CUSTOMER_OF
edge_types.description: Source is a buyer/holder of target's issued securities
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 是 target 所发行证券的客户/持有方（如SAFE持有美国国债）

edge_types.name: REGULATES
edge_types.description: Source has statutory authority over target's budget/issuance
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 立法/授权约束 target（国会监管财政部的借债与支出）

edge_types.name: SUPPORTS
edge_types.description: Source provides analytical or operational support to target
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 为 target 提供支持（纽约联储模型团队支持FOMC决策）

edge_types.name: TRIGGERS
edge_types.description: Indicator or decision that causally triggers repricing of an instrument
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 触发 target 的重定价（如期限溢价升破1%推升10Y收益率）

edge_types.name: CONSTRAINS
edge_types.description: Institutional or fiscal constraint limiting yield direction or policy space
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 约束 target（债务上限/停摆约束收益率路径；CBO基线约束国会财政空间）

edge_types.name: REPORTS_ON
edge_types.description: Passive source publishes forecasts or coverage of instruments/actors
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 报道/预测 target，不构成因果关系

analysis_summary: 本预测问题聚焦2027年12月31日美国10年期国债收益率（DGS10）水平，核心驱动链条为：美联储加息路径与资产负债表政策→短端与期限溢价；财政部发行结构与财政赤字→供给溢价；BOJ正常化与中日减持（TIC）→境外需求；衰退概率与通胀预期→实际利率。本体保留actor阵容种子类型Government/Person/Organization（对应6个政府机构、5个组织、1个自然人决策者），并新增4个领域类型：TreasuryInstrument（可追踪资产客体）、MacroIndicator（判别情景的信号序列，含触发阈值）、ForecastSource（被引用的卖方/调查/预测市场，tier=3被动信息源）。关系覆盖已实证的六条种子边（INFLUENCES/SUPPLIES/COMPETES_WITH/CUSTOMER_OF/REGULATES/SUPPORTS），并新增TRIGGERS/CONSTRAINS两条因果边（带sign/lag/strength）刻画期限溢价、债务上限等冲击向收益率的传导，以及REPORTS_ON信息边区分被动来源与能动主体。
